## 席位核对
ACCEPT — one card, one PR, not governed (`check-governed-merges.mjs`: NOT governed), +239/-75, Clause-② no, Metadata-protocol none.

1. **Shape.** `Fixes #36488`; no other card bound; five files: `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`, its new test file, `affordanceGrants.ts` (JSDoc only), `content/docs/permissions/attachments-access.mdx`, one changeset.
2. **Premise measured.** The removal door lets the uploader delete their own row with no delete grant: dev ran `attachment-removal-routes.integration.test.ts` (16/16) and the member-attachment dogfood baseline before writing the panel change.
3. **Code read.** `handleDelete` sends the caller's own row to `DELETE /api/v1/attachments/:id` and every other row to the data door; `canDeleteRow = isOwnUpload(row) || canDelete`, `canRename = isOwnUpload(row) || canEditAttachments`. The new describe pins own-row Delete and Rename offered and succeeding, and another member's row offering neither; two ablations went red (5 of 16, 2 of 16).
4. **Gates.** 52 success, 10 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending at this head; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check green; dev's 73 gates with 0 NOT MEASURED.
5. **Accepted deviations.** (a) Rename on another user's row no longer needs the delete grant: the rename door asks the edit grant and the update gate, never delete, so the old gate was the panel's own. (b) The docs page edited is under `content/docs/permissions/` (surface amended in 7088583497); sentence read against the diff, it now says the uploader deletes and renames their own file with no grant. (c) `l1-face` flags `@object-ui/core` with no changeset entry: its diff is two JSDoc comments on `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS`, no runtime change, so no release note is owed for it; the user-visible change is covered by the app-shell patch changeset.
6. **Out of scope.** The panel still cannot see the parent-editor half of the server delete rule; a delete-grant holder keeps Delete on every row and sees the server refusal, unchanged.

Landing: area lands it (non-governed, under 3000 lines): ready + auto-merge.
